references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a lean dark-brown ghoul standing wide-legged with clawed hands out to the sides, a gold circlet on the brow and a black loincloth.
Shipped ghoul (tan low crawler): the ghoulking is a darker umber, upright, broad-shouldered ghoul wearing a bright gold crown, arms spread with claws.

prompt_fields.subject: A ghoulking seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: an upright broad-shouldered ghoul with leathery mid-light warm tan-brown skin (light saddle brown) lit with bright sand-tan highlights, standing wide-legged with both arms spread out and low, long pale bone-coloured claws on each hand, a heavy jaw with pointed teeth and glowing pale-yellow eyes, a bright polished gold crown of spikes on the brow, gold bands on the arms, a ragged brick-red loincloth. Regal, cruel and complete, clearly lit.
prompt_fields.contrast: Ghoul family: the shipped ghoul is a tan low crawler and the ghast a pale grey-green hunched brute with dangling arms. The ghoulking is the UMBER-brown one with a gold crown, standing upright with arms spread (silhouette: wide stance, arms spread, spiked crown on top; hue: umber brown with bright gold; value: mid with bright gold highlights).
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it was drawn too dark to read at 48px on a dark floor. This time the creature is clearly LIGHTER and more saturated in every lit plane while the disc stays exactly at the reference lightness: brighter mid-light body colours, strong lighter highlight planes on the upper-left of every fold and limb, no large black or near-black areas anywhere on the body.
prompt_fields.palette: Mid-light saddle-brown skin with bright sand-tan highlights, bright gold crown and arm bands, brick-red loincloth, pale bone claws, pale-yellow eyes; nothing on the body darker than mid-dark, only small seams; no glow or light cast onto the disc. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
